name: afternoon_profit_fade
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, when the index has moved more than 0.5% from session open by 14:45 IST, a predictable mean-reversion impulse emerges as leveraged retail and intraday prop-desk participants simultaneously unwind directional positions to avoid NSE EOD MTM margin calls and overnight risk. This creates concentrated one-sided order flow — heavy selling on strong up-days, aggressive covering on down-days — that pushes the index 15-25 spot points back toward session VWAP in the 14:45-15:15 window. BANKNIFTY exhibits a stronger version of this pattern given its higher retail F&O participation and leverage ratios. At 5-second bars we enter precisely as the unwinding flow begins at 14:45 rather than waiting for a full 1-minute bar confirmation, capturing the first leg of the VWAP reversion.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each day_id
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP — no lookback needed as it accumulates from bar 1. Target for the mean-reversion fade: on a strong up-day NIFTY is above VWAP and sellers push it back; on a down-day buyers absorb and lift it. VWAP is the natural magnet for EOD position liquidation.

indicators.name: day_return
indicators.purpose: Intraday return from the day's first bar close. Original used 375 bars (full day at 1-min) — but this is simply a measure of 'how much has NIFTY moved today'. No scaling needed: it is the cumulative price change from session open to now, available at every bar. Threshold 0.5% for index vs original's 3% for stocks — index moves are compressed by diversification.

conditions: close < vwap_session (still below VWAP, reversion not yet started)
buy_ce.confirmation: none — enter at 5-second bar close to capture start of covering rally

conditions: close > vwap_session (still above VWAP, fade not yet started)
buy_pe.confirmation: none — enter at 5-second bar close to capture start of profit-booking selloff

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts (~10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). If NIFTY moves 10 pts further against the fade direction within the first 2 minutes, end-of-day liquidation flow has not materialized — either the day's trend is extending on fresh news or the position squaring hasn't started, meaning the thesis is wrong for this session.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts (~16 NIFTY spot pts). Afternoon VWAP reversion on NIFTY covers 15-25 spot pts in the 14:45-15:10 window during trend-days. Targeting 8 pts captures the lower end of expected reversion (1:1.6 R:R) — conservative given that not all fades reach full VWAP, some stall at the midpoint.

filters.vix_filter: none — afternoon fade works in both high and low VIX regimes as EOD margin pressure is calendar-driven
filters.time_filter: strictly 14:45-15:20 IST (885-920 min). No trades outside this window — the profit-booking behavior is only concentrated in this period.
filters.trend_filter: day_return threshold acts as implicit trend filter — only trade when intraday move is large enough to trigger meaningful position liquidation

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — structural. EOD margin pressure is a persistent feature of NSE F&O market microstructure, driven by broker risk management systems that auto-square positions. This is a regulatory mechanism, not a behavioral bias.

adaptation_notes: The original traded individual NIFTY100 stocks with >3% daily moves. Converted to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index with 0.5% threshold — stocks need larger moves because idiosyncratic volatility dominates, while the index move of 0.5% is sufficient to attract concentrated position-squaring flow (0.5% of NIFTY ≈ 110 pts, which triggers broker auto-square thresholds for highly leveraged retail F&O positions). The VWAP target from the original is preserved exactly — EOD liquidators push toward VWAP regardless of whether it's individual stocks or the index. Hold time compressed from 15-30 minutes to 10 minutes (120 bars) because at 5-second resolution the entry captures the beginning of the fade, not a lagged 1-minute confirmation; the first 5-10 minutes captures the bulk of the reversion before close-proximity effects create noise.
weaknesses: Strong intraday trends can accelerate rather than fade near close — momentum ignition events (FII program trades, short squeezes) override the EOD liquidation pressure
On event days (budget, Fed, election results), the afternoon window may see continued directional flow rather than mean reversion
BANKNIFTY's expiry day (every Wednesday) sees anomalous options-driven hedging flows that distort the pattern — gamma hedging by market makers overwhelms the mean-reversion
Low-conviction days (day_return near threshold, 0.4-0.6%) produce noisy signals since not enough participants are underwater to trigger forced liquidation
